# Loop over input items and add a new field called 'my_new_field' to the JSON of each one
output = []

chunk_size = 500
overlap = 50

for item in _items:
    data = item["json"]
    text = data.get("text", "")

    start = 0
    chunk_number = 0

    while start < len(text):

        end = start + chunk_size
        chunk = text[start:end]

        output.append({
            "json": {
                "chunk_id": f'{data.get("title", "document")}_{chunk_number}',
                "text": chunk,
                "title": data.get("title", ""),
                "date": data.get("date", ""),
                "type": data.get("type", ""),
                "link": data.get("link", "")
            }
        })

        chunk_number += 1

        if end >= len(text):
            break

        start = end - overlap

return output

# Loop over input items and add a new field called 'my_new_field' to the JSON of each one


lines = []

for item in _items:
    data = item["json"]

    def escape_string(value):
        if value is None:
            return ""
        value = str(value)
        value = value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        value = value.replace('"', '\\"')
        value = value.replace("\n", "\\n")
        value = value.replace("\r", "\\r")
        return value

    embedding = data.get("embedding", [])

    embedding_text = "[" + ",".join(str(x) for x in embedding) + "]"

    document = (
        '{"id":"' + escape_string(data.get("chunk_id", "")) + '",'
        '"chunk_id":"' + escape_string(data.get("chunk_id", "")) + '",'
        '"text":"' + escape_string(data.get("text", "")) + '",'
        '"title":"' + escape_string(data.get("title", "")) + '",'
        '"date":"' + escape_string(data.get("date", "")) + '",'
        '"type":"' + escape_string(data.get("type", "")) + '",'
        '"link":"' + escape_string(data.get("link", "")) + '",'
        '"embedding":' + embedding_text +
        '}'
    )

    lines.append(document)

return [
    {
        "json": {
            "ndjson": "\n".join(lines)
        }
    }
]
